entries.title: Hytale
entries.definitive_edition: Official Early Access launcher build at documented patch state

primary.why: Hytale was cancelled in 2025, revived by its original founder, and released in early access on January 13, 2026. Because it is explicitly unfinished and update-driven, the archive route must capture the exact launcher build, world generation, server/mod state, and early-access caveats.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official Hytale launcher. Record build/date, edition, platform, world seed, solo or server state, mods, settings, account state, and which early-access systems were present at the time of play.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official playable route as of this checkpoint.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Early access is playable but unfinished; build date and feature state define the route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact build/date, edition, mods, server state, and early-access limitations.
